title: ADhammer live-validation receipt
description: Schema for docs/receipts/<version>__<label>.json — one JSON receipt per live-validation run against a DC or a captured environment (Kali PTY, release-evidence, etc.). Companion markdown file at the same basename is human-readable evidence. Enforced by scripts/validate_receipt.py and the ci.yml validate-receipts job.

version.description: adhammer semver (matches [workspace.package].version at the tested commit).

windows_label.description: The environment/target flavor. Standard live-DC labels are the Server year (2019/2022/2025); Kali PTY receipts use 'kali'; consolidated per-release evidence uses 'release-evidence'.

binary_sha256.description: sha256 of the adhammer binary that produced the outputs. Lowercase hex, 64 chars. For consolidated receipts, may reference the release-build binary.

review_status.description: Review state. 'pending' fails scripts/check_validation_ledger.py — a receipt cannot claim release-readiness while pending. 'approved (reviewed by <name>, <date>, ...)' is the passing state. 'rejected (...)' preserves the receipt as a negative record.

verbs.description: Optional per-verb table (used by DC live-run receipts). Consolidated receipts may omit this and describe verbs in the markdown companion instead.

status.description: Outcome. 'pass' + rc=0, 'fail (rc=<n>)' with the exit code, 'refused (<why>)' for a hardened-target refusal that is the expected finding, 'skipped (<why>)' for an env-blocked verb.
